Cr. Appeal (DB) No. 320 of 2025  -------
Rohit Shukla ...... .... Appellant(s)
 Versus The State of Jharkhand ..... .... Respondent  --------
CORAM :
MR. JUSTICE RONGON MUKHOPADHYAY HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE AMBUJ NATH

--------
For the Appellant(s) : Mr. Sabyasanchi, Advocate For the State : Mr. Arup Kr. Dey, A.P.P  --------
04/ Dated 07.05.2025 I.A. No. 4759 of 2025 Heard Mr. Sabyasanchi, learned counsel for the appellant and Mr. Arup Kr. Dey, learned A.P.P on behalf of the State.
This interlocutory application has been preferred by the appellant for grant of bail to him during the pendency of this appeal.
The appellant has been convicted for the offence under Section 376 of the Indian Penal Code and has been sentenced to undergo R.I. for ten years.
It has been alleged that the daughter of the informant was enticed away by the appellant.
Subsequently, in course of search, an amount of Rs.2,50,000/- was demanded from the informant by the accused persons in lieu of getting his daughter safely back home.
It has been submitted by the learned counsel for the appellant that the victim is a major and admittedly, there was a love affair between the victim and the appellant.

He has referred to the evidence of P.W.2 who is the victim of the case, while submitting that on account of the physical relationship between the appellant and victim, she had also given a birth to a child.

sentences.text: Learned A.P.P on behalf of the State has opposed the prayer for bail.

Regard being had to the evidence of P.W.2, from which, it appears that there was a love affair between the appellant and the victim and she stayed at various places with the appellant, we are inclined to admit the appellant on bail.

Accordingly, during the pendency of this appeal, the appellant is directed to be released on bail,
on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 10,000/- (Rs. Ten Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Additional Sessions Judge-II, Nagar Untari, in connection with Bhawnathpur P.S. Case No.119/2017, corresponding to S.T. No.206/2019.
The aforesaid I.A. stands allowed and disposed of.

(Rongon Mukhopadhyay, J.) (Ambuj Nath, J.) BS/-
